Respectfully Quoted: A Dictionary of Quotations.  1989.

 

NUMBER:

1409

AUTHOR:

Henry Adams (1838–1918)

QUOTATION:

Practical politics consists in ignoring facts.

ATTRIBUTION:

HENRY ADAMS,
 
The Education of Henry Adams,
 ed. Ernest Samuels, 
chapter 24
, p. 373 (1973). Originally published in 1906.
He was the son of Charles Francis Adams, the grandson of John Quincy Adams, and the great-grandson of John Adams.

SUBJECTS:

Politics
